entries.title: Qualifying to the flag, a new approach: the Restarts' own dots, no lines through the grid slot

values.label: the split (default): every race one dot, stacked over how many places he moved from qualifying to the flag; lost on the left, made up on the right, held in the middle. The dots leave the held column on reveal. 'By series' lifts them into one row per chapter
the runs: one row per race, a ring where he qualified and a dot where he finished, front of the grid on the right, joined by a thin run; biggest gain first
round 2's places-gained lines (the version Jack called clunky)

entries.look: Career → More from the archive → Qualifying to the flag. Watch the dots leave the 'held' column for their places; flip All races / By series and watch them regroup. Point at (or tap) any dot for the race, its track and both places; click (or tap again) to open the race.

entries.title: Biggest climbs without the ladders: one clean run per climb

values.label: the runs (default): five rows, each the race's field as one hairline (front on the right), a ring at his grid slot and a gold dot at his finish; the dot runs forward on reveal
the rise: the same five as columns, P1 at the top, the dot rising from grid slot to finish
round 2's five ladders (rails and a rung per grid slot)

entries.look: Career → More from the archive → Biggest climbs. Watch the five dots run from grid slot to finish; point at (or tap) a climb for the race and its track; click (or tap again) to open it.

entries.title: The rivals' tyres, cleaner: a race slick (rubber, wheel, hub)

values.label: slick (default): black rubber, a gold wheel for Bryce and silver for the rival, a hub, two white sidewall marks (top and bottom) that show the roll
the same with five straight spokes (at actual size they read as stars)
round 2's tyre (tread ring, gold stripe, tapered spokes)

entries.look: Career → More from the archive → The rivals. Every rivals layout (?ddrivals=tyres, grid, the phone board) uses the same tyre. Watch them roll in; point at one for the race.
